This is, essentially, a new McLaren F1! There’s a 690hp V12 in the middle, a central driver’s seat, and it’s the work of Gordon Murray, creator of the OG Big Mac from the early 1990s. In this video, the great man himself talks Top Gear around his new three-seat supercar homage…
GMSV S1
Jack Rix
This is a commercial channel from BBC Studios.
